commit_message:
Fix Tapjacking caused by touch slipping out of letterbox

Touch can slip out of the black bar of a Letterbox (the box that surrounds a screen when an app's orientation changes). This allows user touch reaches bottom layer of other activities without seeing it (covered by the Letterbox). The Letterbox window is considered trusted system windows. That causes existing tapjacking prevention mechanism not working correctly. This fix is to let the Letterbox assume the identity of the app it is surrounding.
